_about: Simple, game-like name pools per culture id from the release's 24 cultures (CUL-01..24). Mostly common, easy-to-read names modelled on real cultures; compound/descriptive bynames. Not yet wired into the game. Staged for later use by src/world/engine/names.js.

CUL-01.flavour: French/Italian-like (Latin heirs of an old empire)

CUL-08.flavour: East/West African-like savanna farmers and gold traders (Swahili/Yoruba/Akan simple)

CUL-11.flavour: Slavic/Baltic-like forest farmers and river traders

CUL-13.flavour: Indian/Bengali-like (with Southeast Asian touches) monsoon rice farmers

CUL-14.flavour: Polynesian/Malay-like island sailors and pearl divers

CUL-15.flavour: Mixed Iberian/Greek/English sailors (pirates and smugglers, nickname-heavy)

CUL-16.flavour: Nature-word names (simple, forest-hunter feel; invented, not tied to one real people)

CUL-18.flavour: Mixed English/Welsh/Flemish/Frisian-like borderers (frontier settlers and outlaws)

CUL-19.flavour: Soft Tolkien-style woodland elves (simple, short, lyrical)

CUL-22.flavour: Gruff short Mongol/Turkic-tinged orc clan names (simple, harsh)

CUL-23.flavour: Harsh eastern-steppe orc names (a little more Mongol/Korean-sounding than the Horde)
